work.composition: axial vertical with crown apex and target base
work.description: Mixed-media collage incorporating compact discs, printed ephemera, football imagery, and iridescent foil arranged around a centered top-down aircraft line drawing. Vertical orange stripes cross the composition; concentric black-and-white target circles, a holographic crown element, and a Rolling Stones tongue logo punctuate the densely layered field.
work.title: Crowned Plane
